models: Host-selected model and effort unchanged. Native ChatGPT image tool; direct Gemini 3.7 Flash static analysis; FAL MiniMax H3 Max for motion. No delegated models or scoring judges.

budget.video_first: 6s 768P at current promotional $0.02/s = $0.12; only one targeted correction if visibly necessary, ceiling $0.24
budget.analysis_mode: static for whole-clip short reference, not agentic
budget.retry: No blind generation retries. Stop paid execution on infrastructure defect.

review: Focused cleanup followed by separate complete-candidate self-review and public verification

criteria_to_evidence.reference: references source/frame/video analysis; equal-width final screenshots
criteria_to_evidence.motion: generated source + encoded asset + real scroll/pause/reduced/hidden proof
criteria_to_evidence.distribution: 18 ZIP source parity, prior17 runtime hashes, production file hashes
criteria_to_evidence.delivery: private main SHA and personal Pages canonical deployment
